# CORE-RSK-01

**Does every known risk have a mitigation, an owner and its residual level?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | RSK: Risk and obligations |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `risks` |

## Rule

Every risk has mitigation, owner and residual, the likelihood and impact left once the mitigation is in place.

- The Open Group, TOGAF Standard 10th Edition, ADM Techniques, Risk Management (`togaf-risk`)
